# SessionRecap

A running tally of your play session: time, money, experience, quests, loot and gathering. An addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (client 1.60.x).

## What it does

SessionRecap keeps count while you play, so at any point you can see how the session is going:

- time played
- money in, money out, and the difference
- experience gained, experience per hour, and a level bar with how long the rest of the level will take at this pace
- levels gained, quests handed in, deaths
- what you gathered (ore, herbs, skins)
- the items you looted most, with their icons

It also keeps your last ten sessions on each character, to compare against.

## Using it

Type `/session` (or `/recap`), or click the pocket-watch button on the minimap, to open the window. The figures update as you play. Counting starts by itself when you log in, with one line in chat to say so.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/session` | Open the window |
| `/session report` | Sum the session up in chat |
| `/session new` | Start a new session now |
| `/session greet` | The line about your session when you log in, on or off |
| `/session button` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/session debug` | What the game has reported this login, to explain a count that stays at zero |

## What counts as a session

A session belongs to one character. Logging out and back in, or reloading the interface, within 15 minutes carries on the same session. After a longer break a new one starts, and you get one line in chat about the last one.

## Good to know

- **Gathering is counted by casts**: each time you mine, pick a herb or skin.
- **Loot is read from the game's own chat lines**, so it counts what you personally received.
- **Nothing is sent anywhere.** It is all saved on your own computer.

## Controller

With a game controller, the **B** button closes the session window, like the X and Escape do. While a window is open, B closes it; once it is closed, B goes back to whatever you have it set to. When a fight starts, B goes straight back to its usual job, even with the window open.

## More from this author

Other small addons for World of Warcraft: Forever, all free:

- **[GatherLog](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/gatherlog)** remembers ore, herbs, fishing pools, skinning spots, chests and rares across all your characters, and guides you back to the best spots.
- **[MouseTip](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/mousetip)** shows tooltips at your mouse cursor.
- **[RangeShade](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rangeshade)** shades action buttons red when your target is out of range.
- **[JunkMate](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/junkmate)** sells junk and repairs at vendors, makes room for loot when your bags are full, and tidies your bank.
- **[AltGlance](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/altglance)** shows all your characters at a glance: level, gold, rested and where you left them.
- **[SwiftQuest](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/swiftquest)** accepts quests and hands them in as soon as you talk to the quest giver, without ever choosing a reward for you.
- **[MacroKit](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/macrokit)** adds ready-made macros for your class and spec, for all nine classes, and never overwrites your own.
- **[ZoomPad](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/zoompad)** puts big + and - buttons on screen that zoom the camera, made for the Steam Deck touchscreen.
- **[GamepadMacros](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/gamepadmacros)** adds ready-made macros for controller and Steam Deck players: heal yourself, use a quest item, save and wear gear, leave a group, emotes.
- **[FDR - Flight Data Recorder](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/fdr-flight-data-recorder)** times every flight-master flight and counts your next one down to landing.

## Installing

Copy this folder into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\` as `SessionRecap`, restart the game, and enable SessionRecap on the character select screen.

## Developing

- `tools\Link-Addon.ps1` links this folder into the game's AddOns folder, so edits are live after `/reload`.
- `python tests/run.py` runs the tests (`pip install lupa` once). They run the addon in real Lua 5.1 against a fake of the game's API.
- `tools\Publish.ps1 -Message "..."` runs the tests and pushes to GitHub. GitHub runs the tests again on every push.

## Releasing

`tools\Publish.ps1 -Message "Release x.y.z" -Tag vx.y.z` publishes and tags. The tag makes GitHub package the addon and attach the zip to a GitHub release.

To also upload to CurseForge and Wago, two things are needed once:

1. Create the project on each site, then add its ID to `SessionRecap.toc`:
   `## X-Curse-Project-ID: 123456` and `## X-Wago-ID: abc123`.
2. Create an upload token on each site and add it to this repository's secrets (Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions) as `CF_API_KEY` and `WAGO_API_TOKEN`.

Before each release: raise `## Version:` in `SessionRecap.toc` and add the version to `CHANGELOG.md`.

releases.notes:
# SessionRecap

## 0.3.5

- **Controller:** when a fight starts, B goes straight back to its usual job, even with a SessionRecap window open (it used to stay on closing the window until the fight ended). It closes the window again once the fight is over.

## 0.3.4

- **Controller:** the B button now closes SessionRecap's window, like the X and Escape. While one is open, B closes it; once it is closed, B does whatever you have it set to again.

## 0.3.3

- Fixed: the minimap button could keep following the mouse after a drag, and then move together with another addon's button sitting on top of it. It now stops the moment you let go.

## 0.3.2

- First release on CurseForge. No changes to how the addon works.

## 0.3.1

- Every figure still at zero is dimmed, not just money, so the ones that have moved stand out.

## 0.3.0

- Money shows with gold, silver and copper coins, as the game does: money in green, money out red, and figures still at zero dimmed.
- A level bar: experience in purple over rested in blue, with how far through the level you are and how long the rest will take at this session's pace.
- Most looted shows each item's icon, with its name in its quality colour.
- The window fits what it holds, growing as earlier sessions fill in, instead of leaving empty space.

## 0.2.0

- A minimap button opens the window. Drag it around the minimap; `/session button` hides it.
- Every login now says one line in chat: that counting has started, that the session is carrying on, or a summary of the last one.
- `/session debug` lists the money and loot events the game has sent this login, to explain a figure that stays at zero.

## 0.1.0

- First version.
